name: Raccoon
group: Animals > Mammals > Wild animals on land > Eats plants and meat

features.claim: A raccoon's body is 40 to 70 cm long, not counting its tail.
features.quote: Head to hindquarters, raccoons measure between 40 and 70 cm (16 and 28 in), not including the bushy tail

features.claim: Its tail is bushy and can be 20 to 40 cm long.
features.quote: not including the bushy tail which can measure between 20 and 40 cm (7.9 and 15.7 in)

features.claim: It has short legs compared with its compact body.
features.quote: As raccoons have short legs compared to their compact torso, they are usually not able to run quickly or jump great distances.

features.claim: It has a pointed nose and small ears.
features.quote: The raccoon has short legs, a pointed nose, small ears, grayish-brown fur, and a bushy tail.

features.claim: Its ears are slightly rounded and edged with white fur.
features.quote: The slightly rounded ears are also bordered by white fur.

features.claim: It has black fur around its eyes, like a bandit's mask, against a white face.
features.quote: The most characteristic physical feature of the raccoon is the area of black fur around the eyes, which contrasts sharply with the surrounding white face coloring.

features.claim: Its tail has alternating light and dark rings.
features.quote: the alternating light and dark rings on the tail

features.claim: Its coat is grayish, mostly gray with some brown.
features.quote: the long and stiff guard hairs, which shed moisture, are usually colored in shades of gray and, to a lesser extent, brown

features.claim: It has dexterous front paws with five fingers and no webbing between them.
features.quote: The five digits of the paws have no webbing between them, which is unusual for a carnivoran.

features.claim: Its claws are sharp and cannot be pulled back.
features.quote: They are able to identify objects before touching them with vibrissae located above their sharp, nonretractable claws.

features.claim: It usually stands flat on its feet, and can stand up on its hind legs.
features.quote: The raccoon, whose method of locomotion is usually considered to be plantigrade, can stand on its hind legs to examine objects with its front paws.

second_reading.claim: Its dense underfur makes up almost 90% of the coat.
second_reading.quote: The dense underfur, which accounts for almost 90% of the coat, insulates against cold weather and is composed of 2 to 3 cm (0.79 to 1.18 in) long hairs.
